CREATE TABLE "public"."erp_app_settings" (
  "key" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "updatedBy" uuid,
  "value" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("key")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."erp_batches" (
  "batchNumber" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdBy" uuid NOT NULL,
  "expiresOn" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "madeOn" text NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "productId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "productionOrderId" uuid,
  "purchaseReceiptId" uuid,
  "quantity" numeric NOT NULL,
  "sourceType" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
  "supplierLotRef" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "erp_batches_dates_781ad94d" CHECK ("expiresOn" IS NULL OR "expiresOn" >= "madeOn"),
  CONSTRAINT "erp_batches_quantity_fc510296" CHECK ("quantity" > 0),
  CONSTRAINT "erp_batches_source_41609188" CHECK ("sourceType" IN ('PRODUCTION', 'PURCHASE', 'OPENING')),
  CONSTRAINT "erp_batches_status_d357ef7b" CHECK ("status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'ON_HOLD', 'RELEASED', 'REJECTED', 'CONSUMED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."erp_calendar_days" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdBy" uuid NOT NULL,
  "date" text NOT NULL,
  "dayType" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "note" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "erp_calendar_days_type_a1bf6376" CHECK ("dayType" IN ('HOLIDAY', 'SHUTDOWN', 'WORKING'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."erp_capas" (
  "action" text NOT NULL,
  "actionType" text NOT NULL,
  "capaNumber" text NOT NULL,
  "completedAt" timestamptz,
  "completionNote" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdBy" uuid NOT NULL,
  "dueDate" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "idempotencyKey" text NOT NULL,
  "ncrId" uuid,
  "ownerName" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'OPEN' NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "verificationNote" text,
  "verifiedAt" timestamptz,
  "verifiedBy" uuid,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "erp_capas_status_bca129da" CHECK ("status" IN ('OPEN', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'DONE', 'VERIFIED', 'CANCELLED')),
  CONSTRAINT "erp_capas_type_eca50f56" CHECK ("actionType" IN ('CORRECTIVE', 'PREVENTIVE'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."erp_leave_requests" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdBy" uuid NOT NULL,
  "days" numeric NOT NULL,
  "decidedAt" timestamptz,
  "decidedBy" uuid,
  "decisionNote" text,
  "employeeId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "fromDate" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "idempotencyKey" text NOT NULL,
  "leaveTypeId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "reason" text NOT NULL,
  "requestNumber" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "toDate" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "erp_leave_requests_dates_5f46a36a" CHECK ("toDate" >= "fromDate" AND "days" > 0),
  CONSTRAINT "erp_leave_requests_status_57fe5f48" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED', 'CANCELLED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."erp_leave_types" (
  "annualDays" numeric DEFAULT '0'::numeric NOT NULL,
  "code" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "paid" bool NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "erp_leave_types_days_fb514958" CHECK ("annualDays" >= 0 AND "annualDays" <= 366),
  CONSTRAINT "erp_leave_types_status_ee520df2" CHECK ("status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'INACTIVE'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."erp_ncrs" (
  "closeNote" text,
  "closedAt" timestamptz,
  "closedBy" uuid,
  "containment" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdBy" uuid NOT NULL,
  "customerId" uuid,
  "description" text NOT NULL,
  "disposition" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "idempotencyKey" text NOT NULL,
  "inspectionId" uuid,
  "ncrNumber" text NOT NULL,
  "productId" uuid,
  "productionOrderId" uuid,
  "quantityAffected" numeric,
  "rootCause" text,
  "severity" text NOT NULL,
  "source" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'OPEN' NOT NULL,
  "supplierId" uuid,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "erp_ncrs_disposition_c259db1c" CHECK ("disposition" IS NULL OR "disposition" IN ('REWORK', 'SCRAP', 'USE_AS_IS', 'RETURN_TO_SUPPLIER', 'REGRADE')),
  CONSTRAINT "erp_ncrs_quantity_01ebca41" CHECK ("quantityAffected" IS NULL OR "quantityAffected" > 0),
  CONSTRAINT "erp_ncrs_severity_e3c48749" CHECK ("severity" IN ('MINOR', 'MAJOR', 'CRITICAL')),
  CONSTRAINT "erp_ncrs_source_f09274fc" CHECK ("source" IN ('INSPECTION', 'IN_PROCESS', 'CUSTOMER', 'SUPPLIER', 'INTERNAL')),
  CONSTRAINT "erp_ncrs_status_3c5226f6" CHECK ("status" IN ('OPEN', 'INVESTIGATING', 'CLOSED', 'CANCELLED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."erp_packing_instructions" (
  "cartonType" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdBy" uuid NOT NULL,
  "customerId" uuid,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "instructions" text,
  "labelling" text,
  "packType" text NOT NULL,
  "packsPerCarton" int4 NOT NULL,
  "productId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
  "unitsPerPack" numeric NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "erp_packing_instructions_quantities_ac11af64" CHECK ("unitsPerPack" > 0 AND "packsPerCarton" > 0),
  CONSTRAINT "erp_packing_instructions_status_ee520df2" CHECK ("status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'INACTIVE'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."erp_product_categories" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "erp_product_categories_status_ee520df2" CHECK ("status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'INACTIVE'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."erp_product_documents" (
  "archivedAt" timestamptz,
  "archivedBy" uuid,
  "content" bytea NOT NULL,
  "documentType" text NOT NULL,
  "fileName" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "mimeType" text NOT NULL,
  "productId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "sha256" text NOT NULL,
  "sizeBytes" int4 NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "uploadedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "uploadedBy" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "erp_product_documents_size_37f354af" CHECK ("sizeBytes" > 0 AND "sizeBytes" <= 5242880),
  CONSTRAINT "erp_product_documents_status_aef30f3b" CHECK ("status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'ARCHIVED')),
  CONSTRAINT "erp_product_documents_type_2b38851f" CHECK ("documentType" IN ('SPECIFICATION', 'DRAWING', 'TEST_REPORT', 'CERTIFICATE', 'IMAGE', 'OTHER'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."erp_product_price_changes" (
  "changedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "changedBy" uuid NOT NULL,
  "effectiveDate" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "newPrice" numeric NOT NULL,
  "previousPrice" numeric NOT NULL,
  "productId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "reason" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "erp_product_price_changes_nonnegative_653eab89" CHECK ("newPrice" >= 0 AND "previousPrice" >= 0)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."erp_production_plan_lines" (
  "dueDate" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "lineNo" int4 NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "planId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "priority" text DEFAULT 'NORMAL' NOT NULL,
  "productId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "productionOrderId" uuid,
  "quantity" numeric NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PLANNED' NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "erp_production_plan_lines_priority_72dbae57" CHECK ("priority" IN ('LOW', 'NORMAL', 'HIGH', 'URGENT')),
  CONSTRAINT "erp_production_plan_lines_quantity_fc510296" CHECK ("quantity" > 0),
  CONSTRAINT "erp_production_plan_lines_status_f23dda36" CHECK ("status" IN ('PLANNED', 'RELEASING', 'RELEASED', 'CANCELLED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."erp_production_plans" (
  "approvedAt" timestamptz,
  "approvedBy" uuid,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdBy" uuid NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "idempotencyKey" text NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "periodEnd" text NOT NULL,
  "periodStart" text NOT NULL,
  "planNumber" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'DRAFT' NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "erp_production_plans_period_a4b7382c" CHECK ("periodEnd" >= "periodStart"),
  CONSTRAINT "erp_production_plans_status_c831a02a" CHECK ("status" IN ('DRAFT', 'APPROVED', 'CLOSED', 'CANCELLED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."erp_shifts" (
  "breakMinutes" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "code" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "endTime" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "startTime" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "erp_shifts_break_592e88e3" CHECK ("breakMinutes" BETWEEN 0 AND 240),
  CONSTRAINT "erp_shifts_status_ee520df2" CHECK ("status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'INACTIVE')),
  CONSTRAINT "erp_shifts_times_82b30b72" CHECK ("startTime" ~ '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$' AND "endTime" ~ '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$' AND "startTime" <> "endTime")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."erp_work_centers" (
  "capacityUnit" text NOT NULL,
  "dailyCapacity" numeric NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "shiftsPerDay" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "stageKey" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "updatedBy" uuid,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "erp_work_centers_capacity_736e7537" CHECK ("dailyCapacity" > 0),
  CONSTRAINT "erp_work_centers_shifts_477ebc18" CHECK ("shiftsPerDay" BETWEEN 1 AND 3)
)
